sanskrit: apa̱ svasu̍r u̱ṣaso̱ nag ji̍hīte ri̱ṇakti̍ kṛ̱ṣṇīr a̍ru̱ṣāya̱ panthā̍m | aśvā̍maghā̱ goma̍ghā vāṁ huvema̱ divā̱ nakta̱ṁ śaru̍m a̱smad yu̍yotam ||
english: Away from her sister Uṣas night retreats; the dark one yields the path to the ruddy Dawn. O Aśvins, rich in horses, rich in cattle, we call upon you — ward off the shaft from us by day and night.

sanskrit: u̱pāyā̍taṁ dā̱śuṣe̱ martyā̍ya̱ rathe̍na vā̱mam a̍śvinā̱ vaha̍ntā | yu̱yu̱tam a̱smad ani̍rā̱m amī̍vā̱ṁ divā̱ nakta̍m mādhvī̱ trāsī̍thāṁ naḥ ||
english: Come near, O Aśvins, to the mortal worshipper, bringing bounty on your chariot. Drive away from us weakness and disease; protect us sweetly by day and night.

sanskrit: ā vā̱ṁ ratha̍m ava̱masyā̱ṁ vyu̍ṣṭau sumnā̱yavo̱ vṛṣa̍ṇo vartayantu | syūma̍gabhastim ṛta̱yugbhi̱r aśvai̱r āśvi̍nā̱ vasu̍mantaṁ vahethām ||
english: May the well-wishers, the mighty ones, turn your chariot at the breaking of this last dawn; come, O Aśvins, bearing wealth on the rein-grasping chariot yoked with horses joined by holy order.

sanskrit: yo vā̱ṁ ratho̍ nṛpatī̱ asti̍ vo̱ḻhā tri̍vandhu̱ro vasu̍mām̐ u̱srayā̍mā | ā na̍ e̱nā nā̍sa̱tyopa̍ yātam a̱bhi yad vā̍ṁ vi̱śvapsnyo̱ jigā̍ti ||
english: That chariot of yours, O lords of men, the bearer, three-seated and richly laden, that reaches at dawn — come to us, O Nāsatyas, upon it, for your all-nourishing car draws near to us.

sanskrit: yu̱vaṁ cyavā̍naṁ ja̱raso̍ 'mumukta̱ṁ ni pe̱dava̍ ūhathur ā̱śum aśva̍m | nir aṁha̍sa̱s tama̍saḥ sparta̱m atri̱ṁ ni jā̍hu̱ṣaṁ śi̍thi̱re dhā̍tam a̱ntaḥ ||
english: You two freed Cyavāna from old age, you transported to Pedu the swift horse; you rescued Atri from distress and darkness, and placed Jāhuṣa within the yielding earth.

sanskrit: i̱yam ma̍nī̱ṣā i̱yam a̍śvinā̱ gīr i̱māṁ su̍vṛ̱ktiṁ vṛ̍ṣaṇā juṣethām | i̱mā brahmā̍ṇi yuva̱yūny a̍gman yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: This is the thought, this is the song, O Aśvins; be pleased with this praise, O mighty bulls. These prayers have come to you, yearning for you — do you ever protect us with blessings.

sanskrit: ā goma̍tā nāsatyā̱ rathe̱nāśvā̍vatā puruśca̱ndreṇa̍ yātam | a̱bhi vā̱ṁ viśvā̍ ni̱yuta̍ḥ sacante spā̱rhayā̍ śri̱yā ta̱nvā̍ śubhā̱nā ||
english: Come, O Nāsatyas, on your chariot rich in cattle, rich in horses, splendid with many lights. All the teams attend upon you, you two who shine beautifully with desirable radiance.

sanskrit: ā no̍ de̱vebhi̱r upa̍ yātam a̱rvāk sa̱joṣa̍sā nāsatyā̱ rathe̍na | yu̱vor hi na̍ḥ sa̱khyā pitryā̍ṇi samā̱no bandhu̍r u̱ta tasya̍ vittam ||
english: Come hither to us with the gods, O Nāsatyas, on your chariot together with Uṣas. For ancestral friendships between you and us endure — the bond is the same; know that bond.

sanskrit: ud u̱ stomā̍so a̱śvino̍r abudhrañ jā̱mi brahmā̍ṇy u̱ṣasa̍ś ca de̱vīḥ | ā̱vivā̍sa̱n roda̍sī̱ dhiṣṇye̱me acchā̱ vipro̱ nāsa̍tyā vivakti ||
english: The praises of the Aśvins have arisen; the kindred hymns and the divine Uṣas attend on Heaven and Earth. The inspired priest declares aloud toward you, O Nāsatyas, who dwell in the two worlds.

sanskrit: vi ced u̱cchanty a̍śvinā u̱ṣāsa̱ḥ pra vā̱m brahmā̍ṇi kā̱ravo̍ bharante | ū̱rdhvam bhā̱nuṁ sa̍vi̱tā de̱vo a̍śred bṛ̱had a̱gnaya̍ḥ sa̱midhā̍ jarante ||
english: When the dawns shine forth, O Aśvins, the poets bring prayers forward to you; divine Savitar has raised his light on high, and the fires blaze greatly with the kindling.

sanskrit: ā pa̱ścātā̍n nāsa̱tyā pu̱rastā̱d āśvi̍nā yātam adha̱rād uda̍ktāt | ā vi̱śvata̱ḥ pāñca̍janyena rā̱yā yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: Come, O Nāsatyas, from behind and from before; O Aśvins, come from below and from above; come from all directions with the wealth belonging to the five peoples — do you ever protect us with blessings.

sanskrit: atā̍riṣma̱ tama̍sas pā̱ram a̱sya prati̱ stoma̍ṁ deva̱yanto̱ dadhā̍nāḥ | pu̱ru̱daṁsā̍ puru̱tamā̍ purā̱jāma̍rtyā havate a̱śvinā̱ gīḥ ||
english: We have crossed to the farther shore of this darkness, offering praise as we strive toward the gods. The hymn calls upon the Aśvins, of many wonders, most excellent, immortal from of old.

sanskrit: ny u̍ pri̱yo manu̍ṣaḥ sādi̱ hotā̱ nāsa̍tyā̱ yo yaja̍te̱ vanda̍te ca | a̱śnī̱tam madhvo̍ aśvinā upā̱ka ā vā̍ṁ voce vi̱dathe̍ṣu̱ praya̍svān ||
english: The dear human Hotṛ has sat down, O Nāsatyas — he who worships and glorifies you. Taste the sweet drink close at hand, O Aśvins; the oblation-offerer calls upon you at the assemblies.

sanskrit: ahe̍ma ya̱jñam pa̱thām u̍rā̱ṇā i̱māṁ su̍vṛ̱ktiṁ vṛ̍ṣaṇā juṣethām | śru̱ṣṭī̱veva̱ preṣi̍to vām abodhi̱ prati̱ stomai̱r jara̍māṇo̱ vasi̍ṣṭhaḥ ||
english: May we have ample breadth of paths for the sacrifice; be pleased with this praise, O mighty bulls. Vasiṣṭha, singing your praises with hymns, has awakened like one sent swiftly to meet you.

sanskrit: upa̱ tyā vahnī̍ gamato̱ viśa̍ṁ no rakṣo̱haṇā̱ sambhṛ̍tā vī̱ḻupā̍ṇī | sam andhā̍ṁsy agmata matsa̱rāṇi̱ mā no̍ mardhiṣṭa̱m ā ga̍taṁ śi̱vena̍ ||
english: May those two conveyors come to our folk — the slayers of demons, assembled, with strong hands. The exhilarating draughts have met together; do not disregard us — come with favour.

sanskrit: ā pa̱ścātā̍n nāsa̱tyā pu̱rastā̱d āśvi̍nā yātam adha̱rād uda̍ktāt | ā vi̱śvata̱ḥ pāñca̍janyena rā̱yā yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: Come, O Nāsatyas, from behind and from before; O Aśvins, come from below and from above; come from all directions with the wealth belonging to the five peoples — do you ever protect us with blessings.

sanskrit: i̱mā u̍ vā̱ṁ divi̍ṣṭaya u̱srā ha̍vante aśvinā | a̱yaṁ vā̍m a̱hve 'va̍se śacīvasū̱ viśa̱ṁ-viśa̱ṁ hi gaccha̍thaḥ ||
english: These morning invocations call upon you, O Aśvins. I summon you here for help, O you rich in mighty deeds, for you go to every dwelling.

sanskrit: yu̱vaṁ ci̱traṁ da̍dathu̱r bhoja̍naṁ narā̱ code̍thāṁ sū̱nṛtā̍vate | a̱rvāg ratha̱ṁ sama̍nasā̱ ni ya̍cchata̱m piba̍taṁ so̱myam madhu̍ ||
english: You two, O lords, have granted wondrous nourishment; urge it on for him who speaks gracious words. Turn your chariot hither with one accord; drink the sweet Soma.

sanskrit: ā yā̍ta̱m upa̍ bhūṣata̱m madhva̍ḥ pibatam aśvinā | du̱gdham payo̍ vṛṣaṇā jenyāvasū̱ mā no̍ mardhiṣṭa̱m ā ga̍tam ||
english: Come near, adorn yourselves, drink the sweet drink, O Aśvins. O mighty bulls, rich in desired wealth, drink the milked draught — do not disregard us, come.

sanskrit: aśvā̍so̱ ye vā̱m upa̍ dā̱śuṣo̍ gṛ̱haṁ yu̱vāṁ dīya̍nti̱ bibhra̍taḥ | ma̱kṣū̱yubhi̍r narā̱ haye̍bhir aśvi̱nā de̍vā yātam asma̱yū ||
english: The horses that swiftly carry you two toward the home of the worshipper — come with swift-going steeds, O divine Aśvins, O lords, eager for us.

sanskrit: adhā̍ ha̱ yanto̍ a̱śvinā̱ pṛkṣa̍ḥ sacanta sū̱raya̍ḥ | tā ya̍ṁsato ma̱ghava̍dbhyo dhru̱vaṁ yaśa̍ś cha̱rdir a̱smabhya̱ṁ nāsa̍tyā ||
english: Indeed, as the Aśvins go, the refreshing foods attend the generous patrons. Grant to the bountiful ones lasting glory and shelter — and to us, O Nāsatyas.

sanskrit: pra ye ya̱yur a̍vṛ̱kāso̱ rathā̍ iva nṛpā̱tāro̱ janā̍nām | u̱ta svena̱ śava̍sā śūśuvu̱r nara̍ u̱ta kṣi̍yanti sukṣi̱tim ||
english: Those who have gone forward unhurt, like chariots, protectors of men — they have grown mighty through their own power, O lords, and they dwell in a beautiful dwelling.

sanskrit: vy u1̱̍ṣā ā̍vo divi̱jā ṛ̱tenā̍viṣkṛṇvā̱nā ma̍hi̱māna̱m āgā̍t | apa̱ druha̱s tama̍ āva̱r aju̍ṣṭa̱m aṅgi̍rastamā pa̱thyā̍ ajīgaḥ ||
english: Uṣas has shone forth, born of heaven, come disclosing her greatness by holy order. She has driven away the hateful, unwelcome darkness; most like the Aṅgiras-priests, she has set the paths in motion.

sanskrit: ma̱he no̍ a̱dya su̍vi̱tāya̍ bo̱dhy uṣo̍ ma̱he saubha̍gāya̱ pra ya̍ndhi | ci̱traṁ ra̱yiṁ ya̱śasa̍ṁ dhehy a̱sme devi̱ marte̍ṣu mānuṣi śrava̱syum ||
english: Be wakeful for us today for great well-being, O Uṣas; reach forth for great good fortune. Place on us, O goddess, brilliant and glorious wealth — O human goddess among mortals, eager for renown.

sanskrit: e̱te tye bhā̱navo̍ darśa̱tāyā̍ś ci̱trā u̱ṣaso̍ a̱mṛtā̍sa̱ āgu̍ḥ | ja̱naya̍nto̱ daivyā̍ni vra̱tāni̍ ā̱pṛ̱ṇanto̍ a̱ntari̍kṣā̱ vy a̍sthuḥ ||
english: These brilliant, immortal rays of visible Uṣas have come; generating divine ordinances, filling the atmosphere, they have spread across the sky.

sanskrit: e̱ṣā syā yu̍jā̱nā pa̍rā̱kāt pañca̍ kṣi̱tīḥ pari̍ sa̱dyo ji̍gāti | a̱bhi̱paśya̍ntī va̱yunā̱ janā̍nāṁ di̱vo du̍hi̱tā bhuva̍nasya̱ patnī̍ ||
english: This one, yoking her team from afar, at once encircles the five settlements. Looking upon the appointed ways of the peoples, she is the daughter of heaven, the mistress of the world.

sanskrit: vā̱jinī̍vatī̱ sūrya̍sya̱ yoṣā̍ ci̱trāma̍ghā rā̱ya ī̍śe̱ vasū̍nām | ṛṣi̍ṣṭutā ja̱raya̍ntī ma̱ghony u̱ṣā u̍cchati̱ vahni̍bhir gṛṇā̱nā ||
english: The youthful bride of the sun, rich in prize horses, mistress of brilliant treasure and riches, praised by sages, O bountiful one — Uṣas shines forth, hymned by the bearers of oblation.

sanskrit: prati̍ dyutā̱nām a̍ru̱ṣāso̱ aśvā̍ś ci̱trā a̍dṛśrann u̱ṣasa̱ṁ vaha̍ntaḥ | yāti̍ śu̱bhrā vi̍śva̱piśā̱ rathe̍na̱ dadhā̍ti̱ ratna̍ṁ vidha̱te janā̍ya ||
english: The ruddy, bright horses of the glittering Dawn were seen carrying Uṣas; she journeys in her shining chariot, all-adorned, bestowing treasure on the pious worshipper.

sanskrit: sa̱tyā sa̱tyebhi̍r maha̱tī ma̱hadbhi̍r de̱vī de̱vebhi̍r yaja̱tā yaja̍traiḥ | ru̱jad dṛ̱ḻhāni̱ dada̍d u̱sriyā̍ṇā̱m prati̱ gāva̍ u̱ṣasa̍ṁ vāvaśanta ||
english: True among the true, great among the great, divine goddess among the adorable gods — breaking open the pens, giving gifts belonging to the cows, the cattle have lowed back in answer to Uṣas.

sanskrit: nū no̱ goma̍d vī̱rava̍d dhehi̱ ratna̱m uṣo̱ aśvā̍vat puru̱bhojo̍ a̱sme | mā no̍ ba̱rhiḥ pu̍ru̱ṣatā̍ ni̱de ka̍r yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: Now bestow on us, O Uṣas, a treasure rich in cattle, rich in heroes, rich in horses and much nourishment. Do not make our sacred grass a reproach among men — do you ever protect us with blessings.

sanskrit: ud u̱ jyoti̍r a̱mṛta̍ṁ vi̱śvaja̍nyaṁ vi̱śvāna̍raḥ savi̱tā de̱vo a̍śret | kratvā̍ de̱vānā̍m ajaniṣṭa̱ cakṣu̍r ā̱vir a̍ka̱r bhuva̍na̱ṁ viśva̍m u̱ṣāḥ ||
english: The immortal, universal light has risen; divine Savitar, all-knowing, has ascended. By the will of the gods the eye was born — Uṣas has made all of the world visible.

sanskrit: pra me̱ panthā̍ deva̱yānā̍ adṛśra̱nn ama̍rdhanto̱ vasu̍bhi̱r iṣkṛ̍tāsaḥ | abhū̍d u ke̱tur u̱ṣasa̍ḥ pu̱rastā̍t pratī̱cy āgā̱d adhi̍ ha̱rmyebhya̍ḥ ||
english: The paths of the gods have appeared before me, unfailing, adorned with riches. The banner of Uṣas appeared in the east; she has come, facing toward us, over the dwellings.

sanskrit: tānīd ahā̍ni bahu̱lāny ā̍sa̱n yā prā̱cīna̱m udi̍tā̱ sūrya̍sya | yata̱ḥ pari̍ jā̱ra i̍vā̱cara̱nty uṣo̍ dadṛ̱kṣe na puna̍r ya̱tīva̍ ||
english: Many indeed were those days in the past at the earlier rising of the sun, from which Uṣas has wandered about like a lover — yet she is never seen striving to return.

sanskrit: ta id de̱vānā̍ṁ sadha̱māda̍ āsann ṛ̱tāvā̍naḥ ka̱vaya̍ḥ pū̱rvyāsa̍ḥ | gū̱ḻhaṁ jyoti̍ḥ pi̱taro̱ anv a̍vindan sa̱tyama̍ntrā ajanayann u̱ṣāsa̍m ||
english: Those ancient seers, righteous and wise, were feast-companions of the gods. Our fathers found the hidden light; with true incantations they brought forth the dawns.

sanskrit: sa̱mā̱na ū̱rve adhi̱ saṁga̍tāsa̱ḥ saṁ jā̍nate̱ na ya̍tante mi̱thas te | te de̱vānā̱ṁ na mi̍nanti vra̱tāny ama̍rdhanto̱ vasu̍bhi̱r yāda̍mānāḥ ||
english: Gathered together in the same pen they know one another and do not strive against each other — they do not transgress the ordinances of the gods, unfailing as they move with riches.

sanskrit: prati̍ tvā̱ stomai̍r īḻate̱ vasi̍ṣṭhā uṣa̱rbudha̍ḥ subhage tuṣṭu̱vāṁsa̍ḥ | gavā̍ṁ ne̱trī vāja̍patnī na u̱cchoṣa̍ḥ sujāte pratha̱mā ja̍rasva ||
english: The Vasiṣṭhas, waking at dawn, praise thee with hymns, O auspicious one, having glorified thee. O Uṣas, leader of cattle, mistress of bounty, O nobly born, shine forth first, age gracefully.

sanskrit: e̱ṣā ne̱trī rādha̍saḥ sū̱nṛtā̍nām u̱ṣā u̱cchantī̍ ribhyate̱ vasi̍ṣṭhaiḥ | dī̱rgha̱śruta̍ṁ ra̱yim a̱sme dadhā̍nā yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: This Uṣas, leader of bounty and gracious words, shining, is praised by the Vasiṣṭhas; bestowing on us long-famed wealth — do you ever protect us with blessings.

sanskrit: upo̍ ruruce yuva̱tir na yoṣā̱ viśva̍ṁ jī̱vam pra̍su̱vantī̍ ca̱rāyai̍ | abhū̍d a̱gniḥ sa̱midhe̱ mānu̍ṣāṇā̱m aka̱r jyoti̱r bādha̍mānā̱ tamā̍ṁsi ||
english: She has shone forth like a youthful girl, rousing all that lives to move. The fire has been kindled for the kindling of men; driving away the darkness, she has made the light.

sanskrit: viśva̍m pratī̱cī sa̱prathā̱ ud a̍sthā̱d ruśa̱d vāso̱ bibhra̍tī śu̱kram a̍śvait | hira̍ṇyavarṇā su̱dṛśī̍kasaṁdṛ̱g gavā̍m mā̱tā ne̱try ahnā̍m aroci ||
english: Facing all, she has arisen in full breadth, wearing her gleaming robe and shining bright. Gold-coloured, fair to behold for the beautiful to look upon, the mother of kine, leader of days, she has shone.

sanskrit: de̱vānā̱ṁ cakṣu̍ḥ su̱bhagā̱ vaha̍ntī śve̱taṁ naya̍ntī su̱dṛśī̍ka̱m aśva̍m | u̱ṣā a̍darśi ra̱śmibhi̱r vya̍ktā ci̱trāma̍ghā̱ viśva̱m anu̱ prabhū̍tā ||
english: Eye of the gods, auspicious, bearing the white horse of beautiful appearance — Uṣas was seen, made manifest by her rays, with brilliant gifts, shining over all the world.

sanskrit: anti̍vāmā dū̱re a̱mitra̍m uccho̱rvīṁ gavyū̍ti̱m abha̍yaṁ kṛdhī naḥ | yā̱vaya̱ dveṣa̱ ā bha̍rā̱ vasū̍ni co̱daya̱ rādho̍ gṛṇa̱te ma̍ghoni ||
english: Shining near your bounty, drive the foe afar; make for us a wide pasture free from fear. Drive away enmity, bring riches, urge your bounty, O bountiful one, toward the singer.

sanskrit: a̱sme śreṣṭhe̍bhir bhā̱nubhi̱r vi bhā̱hy uṣo̍ devi prati̱rantī̍ na̱ āyu̍ḥ | iṣa̍ṁ ca no̱ dadha̍tī viśvavāre̱ goma̱d aśvā̍va̱d ratha̍vac ca̱ rādha̍ḥ ||
english: Shine upon us, O Uṣas, goddess, with your finest rays, extending our life. Bestowing on us refreshment, O all-choosing one, and a bounty rich in cattle, rich in horses, rich in chariots.

sanskrit: yāṁ tvā̍ divo duhitar va̱rdhaya̱nty uṣa̍ḥ sujāte ma̱tibhi̱r vasi̍ṣṭhāḥ | sāsmāsu̍ dhā ra̱yim ṛ̱ṣvam bṛ̱hanta̍ṁ yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: You whom the Vasiṣṭhas magnify, O Uṣas, daughter of heaven, nobly born, with their thoughts — do thou bestow upon us sublime and lofty wealth — do you ever protect us with blessings.

sanskrit: prati̍ ke̱tava̍ḥ pratha̱mā a̍dṛśrann ū̱rdhvā a̍syā a̱ñjayo̱ vi śra̍yante | uṣo̍ a̱rvācā̍ bṛha̱tā rathe̍na̱ jyoti̍ṣmatā vā̱mam a̱smabhya̍ṁ vakṣi ||
english: The first banners have appeared; the anointing beams of this Dawn spread upward. O Uṣas, bring to us wealth on your great, luminous chariot drawn hitherward.

sanskrit: prati̍ ṣīm a̱gnir ja̍rate̱ sami̍ddha̱ḥ prati̱ viprā̍so ma̱tibhi̍r gṛ̱ṇanta̍ḥ | u̱ṣā yā̍ti̱ jyoti̍ṣā̱ bādha̍mānā̱ viśvā̱ tamā̍ṁsi duri̱tāpa̍ de̱vī ||
english: The kindled fire blazes in her honour; the inspired priests hymn her with their thoughts. Uṣas comes with light, the goddess, driving away all darkness and ill.

sanskrit: e̱tā u̱ tyāḥ praty a̍dṛśran pu̱rastā̱j jyoti̱r yaccha̍ntīr u̱ṣaso̍ vibhā̱tīḥ | ajī̍jana̱n sūrya̍ṁ ya̱jñam a̱gnim a̍pā̱cīna̱ṁ tamo̍ agā̱d aju̍ṣṭam ||
english: There, those shining dawns were seen in the east, stretching out their light. They brought forth the sun, the sacrifice, the fire; the hateful darkness has gone away to the west.

sanskrit: ace̍ti di̱vo du̍hi̱tā ma̱ghonī̱ viśve̍ paśyanty u̱ṣasa̍ṁ vibhā̱tīm | āsthā̱d ratha̍ṁ sva̱dhayā̍ yu̱jyamā̍na̱m ā yam aśvā̍saḥ su̱yujo̱ vaha̍nti ||
english: She, the bountiful daughter of heaven, has become visible; all behold the shining Uṣas. She has mounted the chariot, harnessed by its own power, which the well-yoked horses draw.

sanskrit: prati̍ tvā̱dya su̱mana̍so budhantā̱smākā̍so ma̱ghavā̍no va̱yaṁ ca̍ | ti̱lvi̱lā̱yadhva̍m uṣaso vibhā̱tīr yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: To you today, with good thoughts, may our bountiful patrons and we ourselves awaken. Rejoice in the shining Uṣases — do you ever protect us with blessings.

sanskrit: vy u1̱̍ṣā ā̍vaḥ pa̱thyā̱3̱̍ janā̍nā̱m pañca̍ kṣi̱tīr mānu̍ṣīr bo̱dhaya̍ntī | su̱sa̱ṁdṛgbhi̍r u̱kṣabhi̍r bhā̱num a̍śre̱d vi sūryo̱ roda̍sī̱ cakṣa̍sāvaḥ ||
english: Uṣas has shone forth, opening the paths of the peoples, awakening the five human settlements. She has climbed the light with well-visible bulls; the sun has opened wide the two worlds with its gaze.

sanskrit: vy a̍ñjate di̱vo ante̍ṣv a̱ktūn viśo̱ na yu̱ktā u̱ṣaso̍ yatante | saṁ te̱ gāva̱s tama̱ ā va̍rtayanti̱ jyoti̍r yacchanti savi̱teva̍ bā̱hū ||
english: They adorn the nights at the ends of heaven; like harnessed folk the Uṣases strive onward. The cows for her turn the darkness round; she extends the light like Savitar's arms.

sanskrit: abhū̍d u̱ṣā indra̍tamā ma̱ghony ajī̍janat suvi̱tāya̱ śravā̍ṁsi | vi di̱vo de̱vī du̍hi̱tā da̍dhā̱ty aṅgi̍rastamā su̱kṛte̱ vasū̍ni ||
english: Uṣas has arisen, most Indra-like, most bountiful; she has brought forth glories for well-being. The divine daughter of heaven, most like the Aṅgiras-priests, apportions riches to the pious.

sanskrit: tāva̍d uṣo̱ rādho̍ a̱smabhya̍ṁ rāsva̱ yāva̍t sto̱tṛbhyo̱ ara̍do gṛṇā̱nā | yāṁ tvā̍ ja̱jñur vṛ̍ṣa̱bhasyā̱ rave̍ṇa̱ vi dṛ̱ḻhasya̱ duro̱ adre̍r aurṇoḥ ||
english: Grant us, O Uṣas, as much bounty as you have given to your singers when being praised. You who, at the bull's roar, opened wide the firm doors of the mountain.

sanskrit: de̱vaṁ-de̍va̱ṁ rādha̍se co̱daya̍nty asma̱drya̍k sū̱nṛtā̍ ī̱raya̍ntī | vyu̱cchantī̍ naḥ sa̱naye̱ dhiyo̍ dhā yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: Spurring god after god to grant bounty, sending forth gracious words toward us — shining forth, do thou set our thoughts toward winning gain — do you ever protect us with blessings.

sanskrit: prati̱ stome̍bhir u̱ṣasa̱ṁ vasi̍ṣṭhā gī̱rbhir viprā̍saḥ pratha̱mā a̍budhran | vi̱va̱rtaya̍ntī̱ṁ raja̍sī̱ sama̍nte āviṣkṛṇva̱tīm bhuva̍nāni̱ viśvā̍ ||
english: The Vasiṣṭha priests, the inspired ones, first awakened Uṣas with their hymns and songs — she who turns the two realms on all sides and reveals all worlds.

sanskrit: e̱ṣā syā navya̱m āyu̱r dadhā̍nā gū̱ḍhvī tamo̱ jyoti̍ṣo̱ṣā a̍bodhi | agra̍ eti yuva̱tir ahra̍yāṇā̱ prāci̍kita̱t sūrya̍ṁ ya̱jñam a̱gnim ||
english: This very one, bestowing new life, hiding the darkness with her light — Uṣas has awakened. She goes in front, the youthful one, unabashed; she has made the sun, the sacrifice, the fire appear.

sanskrit: aśvā̍vatī̱r goma̍tīr na u̱ṣāso̍ vī̱rava̍tī̱ḥ sada̍m ucchantu bha̱drāḥ | ghṛ̱taṁ duhā̍nā vi̱śvata̱ḥ prapī̍tā yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: May the auspicious Uṣases always shine forth for us, rich in horses, rich in cattle, rich in heroes. Milking ghee, satiated on every side — do you ever protect us with blessings.
